evals.prompt: We want to deploy a production MSK Express cluster across only 2 Availability Zones with 2 brokers total, attach 4 TB GP3 EBS volumes to each Express broker, and set `min.insync.replicas=3` with `replication.factor=2`. Generate the AWS CLI command to create this cluster.
evals.expected_output: Strong architectural pushback explaining three impossible/broken configurations in the request: (1) MSK Express strictly requires 3 AZs (and broker counts in multiples of 3), (2) MSK Express uses AWS-managed storage and does not accept user-provisioned EBS volumes, and (3) `min.insync.replicas=3` with `replication.factor=2` causes every producer write with `acks=all` to fail with `NotEnoughReplicasException`.
expectations: Explains that Amazon MSK Express brokers strictly require 3 Availability Zones and broker counts in multiples of 3 (minimum 3 brokers), and that Express brokers use AWS-managed storage rather than user-configured EBS volumes (`references/size-and-choose-cluster.md`).

Explains why `min.insync.replicas=3` with `replication.factor=2` is invalid (ISR count can never exceed replication factor, causing `acks=all` writes to fail with `NotEnoughReplicasException`), and recommends `replication.factor=3` with `min.insync.replicas=2`.
Provides the corrected 3-AZ MSK Express (or 2-AZ MSK Standard) cluster configuration.
